townhall.line: A photograph taken on March 28, 2005, at a town hall meeting in Port Charlotte, Florida. After the 2004 hurricanes, residents came to ask state and national government officials for help. Photo by Andrea Booher for FEMA. Free to use.

market.line: A photograph taken in 2020 at the Mache Ayisyen, which means “Haitian Market,” in the Little Haiti neighborhood of Miami. Photo by Carol M. Highsmith. Library of Congress. Free to use.
